content_md:
## What Is Mintly?

Mintly (usemintly.com) by FLAME INDUSTRIES INC. is an AI ad generator for e-commerce and DTC brands. Create static and video ad creative from product links. Listed on Microsoft Marketplace. Offers a 20% lifetime commission affiliate program.

## Key Features for Print Shops and POD Sellers

### AI Ad Generation
Generate ad creative from your product URLs. Static image ads + video ads optimized for social media platforms.

### E-Commerce Focus
Built specifically for DTC/e-commerce brands. Product feeds dynamic creative optimization.

### Microsoft Marketplace
Listed as a verified SaaS app adding enterprise credibility.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Features |
|------|-------|----------|
| Free | $0 | Basic ad generation limited exports |
| Starter | $19/mo | Standard templates up to 50 ads/mo |
| Growth | $49/mo | Advanced templates unlimited ads (Most Popular) |
| Scale | $199/mo | Custom branding API access priority support |

## Affiliate Program

20% lifetime commission 90-day cookie window. Top affiliates earn ~$2980/mo average. Join via the Microsoft Marketplace listing or usemintly.com/affiliates.

## Verdict

Use it if: Your POD store needs ad creative for Facebook/Instagram/TikTok marketing and you want the best affiliate commissions.

Skip it if: You need product mockups or print-specific tools this is ad creative only.
